blocks.text: Ikki xil savol bor: «Hozir qanday?» va «Bu holat **qachondan beri** davom etyapti?». Birinchisiga hozirgi zamon javob beradi: She **is** ill. Ikkinchisiga — Present Perfect: She**'s been** ill for three days. O'zbekchada esa ikkalasida ham hozirgi zamon: «U **kasal**. U uch kundan beri **kasal**.» Shuning uchun o'zbek o'quvchi ko'pincha «She is ill for three days» deb yuboradi. Qizil kitobda bu mavzu boshlangan (→ qizil kitob, 18-dars), bu yerda uni oxirigacha yechamiz.

rows: She**'s been** married for five years.
I**'ve been** in London since Monday.
He**'s been learning** it for a year.
We**'ve known** each other since school.
They**'ve had** it for ten years.

blocks.text: Qoida oddiy: holat **o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etyapti** va biz uning davomiyligini aytyapmiz — Present Perfect. Hozirgi zamon (I am, I know, I live) davomiylik bilan ishlatilmaydi. Ayniqsa xavfli juftlik: **How long are you here for?** — «Bu yerga qancha **muddatga** keldingiz?» (butun muddat, kelajakni ham o'z ichiga oladi) va **How long have you been here?** — «Kelganingizga qancha **bo'ldi**?» (boshlanishdan hozirgacha). Xuddi shunday: I**'m** here **for** two weeks — ikki haftaga keldim; I**'ve been** here **for** two weeks — kelganimga ikki hafta bo'ldi.

items.text: How long **are** you here for? — For a week.
items.translation: Bu yerga qancha **muddatga keldingiz**? — Bir haftaga.

items.text: How long **have** you **been** here? — Since Saturday.
items.translation: Bu yerga kelganingizga qancha **bo'ldi**? — Shanbadan beri.

blocks.text: Qaysi Perfect shaklni tanlash fe'lga bog'liq. **Faol jarayon** (wait, learn, rain, drive, work on) — have been + -ing (→ 9-dars). **Holat fe'llari** (be, know, have = ega, like, believe, want) — faqat have + V3 (→ 4-dars). **live, work, study, teach** bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, farq kam: Continuous holatning vaqtinchaligiga yoki davomiylikka urg'u beradi. **always** bilan esa odatda have + V3: I**'ve always lived** here.

rows: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.
I**'ve lived** / I**'ve been living** here for ten years.

items.text: I**'ve always lived** in this street, and I know every family here.
items.translation: Men **doim** shu ko'chada **yashab kelganman**, bu yerdagi har bir oilani taniyman.

items.text: We**'ve been working** on this project since spring.

blocks.text: Inkor: I haven't seen him for ...

Inkor gap + for / since — oxirgi marta qachon bo'lganini bildiradi: I **haven't seen** Madina for two years = oxirgi marta uni ikki yil oldin ko'rganman. O'zbekchada bunga ajoyib mos qolip bor: «**...-maganimga ... bo'ldi**»: «Uni **ko'rmaganimga** ikki yil **bo'ldi**». It**'s** two years **since** I last saw her kabi qolip → 12-dars.

items.text: We **haven't had** a proper holiday since 2022.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I know him for ten years.» → I**'ve known** him for ten years.; «I am married for five years.» → I**'ve been** married for five years.; «How long are you in London?» («qachondan beri» ma'nosida) → How long **have** you **been** in London?; «I live here since 2010.» → I**'ve lived** here since 2010.; «It is raining since morning.» → It**'s been raining** since morning.; «I didn't see him for two years.» → I **haven't seen** him for two years.

O'zbekcha gapda «**-dan beri**» yoki «**...-ganimga ... bo'ldi**» bo'lsa, inglizcha gapda oddiy hozirgi zamon bo'lmaydi — **have / has** kerak: is → **has been**, know → **have known**, am waiting → **have been waiting**, don't see → **haven't seen**.

for va since farqi, When ...? va How long ...?, It's two years since ... → 12-dars. Present Perfect Continuous → 9-dars; jarayon va natija → 10-dars. Holat tugagan bo'lsa (We **lived** in Bukhara for ten years — endi u yerda yashamaymiz) — Past Simple (→ 5, 13–14-darslar).

rows: It**'s been raining** for two hours.
He**'s lived** / **been living** here for a year.
How long **are** you here for? (umumiy muddat)

examples.title: Now and since when: **is** / **has been**
examples.description: Hozirgi holat — am / is / are; u qachondan beri davom etayotgani — have / has been. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham hozirgi zamon.

sentences.text: My uncle **is** in Moscow on business. He**'s been** there for three weeks.
sentences.translation: Amakim xizmat safari bilan **Moskvada**. U **uch haftadan beri** o'sha yerda.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Aziz **are** married. They**'ve been** married for twelve years.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan Aziz **turmush qurishgan**. Ular **o'n ikki yildan beri** er-xotin.

sentences.text: Sarah **is** a teacher, and she**'s been** a teacher since she was twenty-two.
sentences.translation: Sara **o'qituvchi**, u yigirma ikki yoshidan beri **o'qituvchilik qiladi**.

sentences.text: The museum **is** closed for repairs — it**'s been** closed since January.
sentences.translation: Muzey ta'mir uchun **yopiq** — u yanvardan beri **yopiq turibdi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you still ill? How long **have** you **been** off work?
sentences.translation: Hali ham **kasalmisiz**? Ishga chiqmaganingizga qancha **bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **is** the captain of the team. He**'s been** captain for two seasons.
sentences.translation: Bekzod jamoa **sardori**. U ikki mavsumdan beri **sardorlik qiladi**.

sentences.text: The lift **is** out of order again, and it**'s been** like that all week.
sentences.translation: Lift yana **ishlamayapti**, butun hafta **shunday holatda**.

sentences.text: Oliver **is** in Tashkent at the moment. He**'s been** here since the conference started.
sentences.translation: Oliver hozir **Toshkentda**. Konferensiya boshlanganidan beri **shu yerda**.

sentences.text: I**'m** so tired — I**'ve been** awake since four o'clock this morning.
sentences.translation: Juda **charchadim** — bugun ertalab soat to'rtdan beri **uyg'oqman**.

sentences.text: Madina **is** a member of the chess club; she**'s been** a member for six years.
sentences.translation: Madina shaxmat klubining **a'zosi**; u olti yildan beri **a'zo**.

examples.title: How long **have** you **been** married / here / ill?
examples.description: be bilan savol va javob: How long have you been married / here / ill / a doctor? Javobda for yoki since. O'zbekchada «qachondan beri ...siz?», «...ganingizga qancha bo'ldi?»

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been** in Edinburgh? — Just a few days.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga kelganingizga qancha **bo'ldi**? — Bir necha kun, xolos.

sentences.text: How long **has** your brother **been** a pilot? — Since 2016.
sentences.translation: Akangiz qachondan beri **uchuvchi**? — 2016-yildan beri.

sentences.text: So, how long **have** you two **been** together? — Almost three years.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, ikkovingiz qancha vaqtdan beri **birgasizlar**? — Deyarli uch yil.

sentences.text: Do you know how long Kate **has been** unemployed?
sentences.translation: Keyt qancha vaqtdan beri **ishsizligini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Jasur **has been** in hospital for a week, but he's getting better.
sentences.translation: Jasur bir haftadan beri **kasalxonada**, lekin tuzalib boryapti.

sentences.text: We**'ve been** members of this gym for years, and the price has never gone up.
sentences.translation: Bir necha yildan beri bu sport zalining **a'zosimiz**, narx esa hech qachon oshmagan.

sentences.text: Exactly how long **has** the shop on the corner **been** empty?
sentences.translation: Burchakdagi do'kon aniq qancha vaqtdan beri **bo'sh turibdi**?

sentences.text: Nilufar **has been** a nurse since she left college.
sentences.translation: Nilufar kollejni bitirganidan beri **hamshira**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **been** here long? — No, I've just arrived.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **ancha bo'ldingizmi**? — Yo'q, hozirgina keldim.

sentences.text: My parents **have been** retired for five years, and they travel a lot.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam besh yildan beri **nafaqada**, ular ko'p sayohat qilishadi.

examples.title: How long **have** you **been** ...**ing**? — action verbs
examples.description: Faol jarayon (wait, learn, work, drive, rain) — have been + -ing. O'zbekchada «qancha vaqtdan beri ... -yapsiz?».

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been waiting** for the bus? — About twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Avtobusni qancha vaqtdan beri **kutyapsiz**? — Yigirma daqiqacha.

sentences.text: How long **has** Emma **been studying** medicine in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Emma Samarqandda qancha vaqtdan beri tibbiyot **o'qiyapti**?

sentences.text: It**'s been snowing** in the mountains for two days, so the ski season has started.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda ikki kundan beri qor **yog'yapti**, shuning uchun chang'i mavsumi boshlandi.

sentences.text: Aziz **has been working** at the same bank for fifteen years.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'n besh yildan beri bitta bankda **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: The kids **have been playing** outside since lunch — call them in for dinner.
sentences.translation: Bolalar tushlikdan beri tashqarida **o'ynashyapti** — kechki ovqatga chaqir.

sentences.text: I**'ve been trying** to call the bank since nine, but the line is always busy.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizdan beri bankka qo'ng'iroq qilishga **urinyapman**, lekin liniya doim band.

sentences.text: Ask James how long he**'s been driving** without a break.
sentences.translation: Jeymsdan qancha vaqtdan beri tanaffussiz **mashina haydayotganini** so'ra.

sentences.text: We**'ve been looking** forward to this holiday for months.
sentences.translation: Bir necha oydan beri bu ta'tilni **intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has been feeling** dizzy since she started the new medicine.
sentences.translation: Yangi dorini ichishni boshlaganidan beri Saraning **boshi aylanyapti**.

sentences.text: Workers **have been building** the new metro line for four years, and it still isn't finished.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar yangi metro liniyasini to'rt yildan beri **qurishyapti**, u esa hali ham tugamadi.

examples.title: State verbs: **have known**, **have had**
examples.description: Holat fe'llari (know, have = ega, like, believe, want, be) bilan faqat have + V3: How long have you known ...? — «Qachondan beri taniysiz?»

sentences.text: I**'ve known** Nilufar since we were in the same class at school.
sentences.translation: Nilufarni maktabda bir sinfda o'qiganimizdan beri **taniyman**.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **had** that car? — About eight years, and it's never broken down.
sentences.translation: U mashina sizda qachondan beri **bor**? — Sakkiz yilcha, hali bir marta ham buzilmagan.

sentences.text: My grandparents **have had** the same sofa since 1990.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvimda 1990-yildan beri bir xil divan **bor**.

sentences.text: Tom **has liked** spicy food ever since his trip to India.
sentences.translation: Hindistonga safaridan beri Tom achchiq taomlarni **yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve known** about the problem for weeks, but nobody has done anything.
sentences.translation: Muammo haqida bir necha haftadan beri **bilamiz**, lekin hech kim hech narsa qilmadi.

sentences.text: Kate **has had** a cold since the weekend, so she's working from home.
sentences.translation: Keyt dam olish kunlaridan beri **shamollagan**, shuning uchun uydan ishlayapti.

sentences.text: **Has** Bekzod always **believed** in his dream of becoming a pilot?
sentences.translation: Bekzod uchuvchi bo'lish orzusiga doim **ishonib kelganmi**?

sentences.text: Our family **has owned** this orchard near Fergana for three generations.
sentences.translation: Oilamiz uch avloddan beri Farg'ona yaqinidagi bu bog'ga **egalik qiladi**.

sentences.text: Ever since I was a child, I**'ve wanted** to see the Northern Lights.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimdan beri shimoliy yog'dularni ko'rishni **xohlayman**.

sentences.text: Jasur and Oliver **have been** friends since they met at a language exchange in London.
sentences.translation: Jasur bilan Oliver Londondagi til almashinuvi tadbirida tanishganlaridan beri **do'st**.

examples.title: **live**, **work** and **always**: both forms
examples.description: live, work, study, teach bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, farq kam: I've lived / I've been living. Continuous vaqtinchalikka urg'u beradi; always bilan — odatda have + V3.

sentences.text: We**'ve lived** in this house since our daughter was born.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz tug'ilganidan beri bu uyda **yashaymiz**.

sentences.text: I**'ve been living** with my cousin since I moved to London — but only until I find a flat.
sentences.translation: Londonga ko'chib kelganimdan beri amakivachcham bilan **yashayapman** — lekin faqat kvartira topgunimcha.

sentences.text: Madina **has worked** as an interpreter for over ten years.
sentences.translation: Madina o'n yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri tarjimon bo'lib **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been teaching** at this school for ten years, and the students love him.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'n yildan beri shu maktabda **dars beradi**, o'quvchilar uni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: My father **has always worked** in agriculture, like his father before him.
sentences.translation: Otam xuddi o'z otasi kabi **doim** qishloq xo'jaligida **ishlab kelgan**.

sentences.text: Emma **has always lived** in Oxford — she's never wanted to leave.
sentences.translation: Emma **doim** Oksfordda **yashab kelgan** — u hech qachon ketishni xohlamagan.

sentences.text: And you, how long **have** you **lived** in Tashkent? — All my life, actually.
sentences.translation: O'zingiz-chi, Toshkentda qachondan beri **yashaysiz**? — Aslida, butun umrim davomida.

sentences.text: Since the factory opened, most people in the town **have worked** there.
sentences.translation: Zavod ochilganidan beri shaharchadagi ko'pchilik odamlar o'sha yerda **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has been studying** law in Manchester for two years, but she's coming home in June.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ikki yildan beri Manchesterda huquqshunoslikni **o'qiyapti**, lekin iyunda uyga qaytadi.

sentences.text: Tom **has always wanted** to live by the sea, but he**'s been living** in Birmingham for twenty years.
sentences.translation: Tom **doim** dengiz bo'yida yashashni **orzu qilgan**, lekin yigirma yildan beri Birmingemda **yashayapti**.

examples.title: Negative: I **haven't seen** him for ...
examples.description: Inkor + for / since: oxirgi marta qachon bo'lgani. O'zbekchada «...-maganimga ... bo'ldi» yoki «...-dan beri ... -magan».

sentences.text: I **haven't seen** Bekzod for two years — I wonder how he is.
sentences.translation: Bekzodni **ko'rmaganimga** ikki yil **bo'ldi** — qalay ekan, bilmayman.

sentences.text: We **haven't been** to the cinema since the pandemic.
sentences.translation: Pandemiyadan beri kinoga **bormadik**.

sentences.text: Kate **hasn't eaten** meat since she watched a documentary about farming.
sentences.translation: Fermerlik haqidagi hujjatli filmni ko'rganidan beri Keyt go'sht **yemaydi**.

sentences.text: It **hasn't rained** here for three months, and the farmers are desperate.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda uch oydan beri yomg'ir **yog'magan**, fermerlar umidsiz ahvolda.

sentences.text: My grandfather **hasn't smoked** a single cigarette since his heart attack.
sentences.translation: Yurak xurujidan beri bobom bitta ham sigaret **chekmagan**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **hasn't heard** from her brother in Korea for weeks.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Koreyadagi akasidan bir necha haftadan beri **xabar olmagan**.

sentences.text: Nobody **has used** this room since the old manager retired.
sentences.translation: Eski menejer nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri bu xonadan hech kim **foydalanmagan**.

sentences.text: **Haven't** you **spoken** to your sister since the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'ydan beri opang bilan **gaplashmadingmi**?

sentences.text: Our team **hasn't lost** a match since the new coach arrived.
sentences.translation: Yangi murabbiy kelganidan beri jamoamiz birorta ham o'yinda **yutqazmagan**.

sentences.text: Oliver **hasn't been** back to Uzbekistan since he finished his research in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Oliver Xivadagi tadqiqotini tugatganidan beri O'zbekistonga **qaytib kelmagan**.

examples.title: How long **are** you here? / How long **have** you **been** here?
examples.description: How long are you here for? — qancha muddatga (butun muddat); How long have you been here? — qachondan beri (hozirgacha). I'm here for ... va I've been here for ... farqi.

sentences.text: How long **are** you **staying** in London? — Until the end of May.
sentences.translation: Londonda qancha **qolasiz**? — May oxirigacha.

sentences.text: And how long **have** you **been** in London? — Since the beginning of March.
sentences.translation: Londonga kelganingizga qancha **bo'ldi**? — Mart boshidan beri.

sentences.text: I**'m** in Tashkent for two weeks — it's a short business trip.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga **ikki haftaga keldim** — bu qisqa xizmat safari.

sentences.text: I**'ve been** in Tashkent for two weeks, and I still haven't seen the old city.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **ikki haftadan beri yuribman**, lekin hali eski shaharni ko'rmadim.

sentences.text: So how long **is** your brother here for? — Just until Sunday.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, akangiz bu yerga qancha **muddatga kelgan**? — Yakshanbagacha, xolos.

sentences.text: Tell me, how long **has** your brother **been** here? — Only since Thursday.
sentences.translation: Ayt-chi, akang bu yerga kelganiga qancha **bo'ldi**? — Payshanbadan beri, xolos.

sentences.text: Sarah **is** on holiday until the fifteenth, so she'll answer next week.
sentences.translation: Sara o'n beshinchigacha **ta'tilda**, shuning uchun kelasi hafta javob beradi.

sentences.text: Sarah **has been** on holiday since Monday, and the office is in chaos.
sentences.translation: Sara dushanbadan beri **ta'tilda**, ofisda esa tartibsizlik.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **are** you **waiting** for the dentist too? — Yes, I**'ve been waiting** for ages.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, siz ham tish shifokorini **kutyapsizmi**? — Ha, **ancha vaqtdan beri kutyapman**.

sentences.text: Our visitors **are staying** for a month, but they**'ve** only **been** here for three days.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarimiz bir oyga **kelishgan**, lekin bu yerga kelganlariga bor-yo'g'i uch kun **bo'ldi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting a new neighbour
examples.description: Yangi qo'shni bilan tanishuv: hozirgi holat (am / is) va qachondan beri (have been, have known, have lived) — savol-javoblar.

sentences.text: — Hello! I think you're the new neighbour. **Are** you settling in OK?
sentences.translation: — Salom! Yangi qo'shni siz bo'lsangiz kerak. Yaxshi **joylashib olyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, thanks. We**'ve been** here for just ten days, so everything is still in boxes.
sentences.translation: — Ha, rahmat. Bu yerga kelganimizga bor-yo'g'i o'n kun **bo'ldi**, hamma narsa hali qutilarda.

sentences.text: — I understand. And where **were** you **living** before?
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. Oldin qayerda **yashardingiz**?

sentences.text: — In Bukhara. My husband **has worked** for the same company for years, and they moved him here.
sentences.translation: — Buxoroda. Erim ko'p yillardan beri bitta kompaniyada **ishlaydi**, uni shu yerga o'tkazishdi.

sentences.text: — I see. **Have** you **been** to the park at the end of our street yet?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Ko'chamiz oxiridagi bog'da hali **bo'ldingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet. **Have** you **lived** in this building long?
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Bu binoda **ancha vaqtdan beri yashaysizmi**?

sentences.text: — Oh yes, I**'ve lived** here since 1998 — I'm the oldest resident!
sentences.translation: — Ha, albatta, 1998-yildan beri shu yerda **yashayman** — eng qadimgi yashovchi menman!

sentences.text: — Then you probably know everyone here. Who **is** the man with the big dog?
sentences.translation: — Unda bu yerdagi hammani tanisangiz kerak. Katta itli erkak **kim**?

sentences.text: — That's Jasur. He**'s been** a vet for twenty years, and he**'s had** that dog since it was a puppy.
sentences.translation: — Bu Jasur. U yigirma yildan beri **veterinar**, o'sha itni kuchukligidan beri **boqadi**.

sentences.text: — Lovely! I**'ve wanted** a dog for ages, but my husband isn't sure.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Ancha vaqtdan beri it **olishni xohlayman**, lekin erim ikkilanyapti.
